briefdescription.para: Handles INIT or UPDATE/FINAL operations for multi-part cryptographic operations with priority-based context management.

para.verbatim: The context created on INIT is tied to the XAsu_ClientParams instance it was created with, so every UPDATE and FINAL call of one multi-part operation must be issued with that same instance. A different instance is rejected with XASU_INVALID_CLIENT_CTX even when it carries a copy of the context pointer. An instance holds a single context, so it can track only one multi-part operation at a time. Starting a second one replaces the context of the first, which can then be neither continued nor finished and holds its priority for the lifetime of the program.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to XAsu_ClientParams structure with priority information.
Pointer to HIGH priority (P0) context.
Pointer to LOW priority (P1) context.

Current operation flags (combination of XASU_INIT, XASU_UPDATE, XASU_FINISH) from the client request. XASU_INIT creates a context, and XASU_FINISH alongside it marks a request that completes within this call and therefore needs none. XASU_FINISH on its own is not examined: every request without XASU_INIT continues the operation that owns the context.
Pointer to store the generated or retrieved Unique ID.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS, if operation is successful.
XASU_INVALID_ARGUMENT, if ClientParamPtr, P0CtxPtr, P1CtxPtr or UniqueIdPtr is NULL.
XASU_INVALID_PRIORITY, if the priority in ClientParamPtr is invalid.
XASU_INVALID_UNIQUE_ID, if generated Unique ID is invalid.
XASU_REQUEST_INPROGRESS, if a multi-part request is already in progress.
XASU_FAIL_SAVE_CTX, if context save fails.
XASU_CLIENT_CTX_NOT_CREATED, if client context does not exist.
XASU_INVALID_CLIENT_CTX, if the context does not belong to this request.

inbodydescription.para: Validate input parameters.
Determine context pointer based on priority.
Check if this is an INIT operation.
Check if context already exists for this priority level.
A request that finishes here needs no context of its own.
Create new context for new multi-part or single-shot operation.
Save context and update client context pointer.
Handle UPDATE/FINAL operation - verify that context exists.

The context must be the one this priority handed out. Starting a second operation through the same client parameters instance replaces the context of the first, and without this check the first one would carry on under the unique ID of the second.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to XAsu_ClientParams structure.
HIGH priority (P0) context.
LOW priority (P1) context.
Unique ID associated with this operation.
Pointer to response buffer address (can be NULL).
Size of the response buffer.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS, if cleanup is successful.
XASU_INVALID_ARGUMENT, if ClientParamPtr, P0CtxPtr or P1CtxPtr is NULL.
XASU_INVALID_CLIENT_CTX, if the context belongs to neither priority of this operation.
Error code from callback update or context free.

inbodydescription.para: Validate input parameters.

A request that owns no context has nothing to release. That is the single-shot request served while a multi-part operation holds the context of its priority. The unique ID is the one the library issued for this request rather than a value taken from the client, so matching the address of its context slot is ownership enough here.

Release only the context this operation was given for its priority. A continuation is bound to that slot by XAsu_HandleContextOperation() before it gets here, so this guards against a caller pairing a context with the priority slots of a different operation.
